generated_from: /Users/berntsen/Projects/blades-capture/reference/game-defs/abilities_full.json  (63 abilities / 706 ranks, AssetRipper export of the APK)
/Users/berntsen/Projects/blades-capture/reference/il2cpp/dump.cs  (enums + serialized field types; NO method bodies)
_meta.rule: Every number here is READ from the authored data. Nothing is invented. Where a described behaviour has no authored field, it is listed under gaps_and_warnings and in the ability's notes instead of being guessed.

json_shape.top_level: flat dict keyed by ability UUID (36-char string); 63 entries

top_level_fields.name: string, resolved en-US display name
top_level_fields.editor_name: string, the Unity editor / class name (NOT always the display name)
top_level_fields.maximum_level: int, total ranks including non-purchaseable bonus ranks
top_level_fields.maximum_purchaseable_level: int, ranks buyable with ability points
top_level_fields.bonus_ranks_offset: int, rank offset at which gear/enchant bonus ranks start
top_level_fields.enemy_only: bool - true means the ability is not player-facing
top_level_fields.tags: int[] decoded from a hex blob -> AbilityTags enum (may be null)
top_level_fields.ranks: array of per-rank objects, sorted by abilityRank ascending

json_shape.field_naming: Unity serialized fields with the LEADING UNDERSCORE STRIPPED. _wardDuration -> wardDuration, _maximumAmountAbsorbed -> maximumAmountAbsorbed. There are NO leading underscores anywhere in this file.
json_shape.rank_fields_subclass_specific: everything else - the set of extra fields IS the ability's C# subclass. See code_schema per ability.

parameters_struct.present_on: maneuvers only (276 of 706 rank rows) - ManeuverAbility._parameters

fields.oneHandedMultiplier: float, scales bonusDamage for a one-handed grip
fields.twoHandedMultiplier: float, scales bonusDamage for a two-handed grip

parameters_struct.not_exported: ManeuverParameters._effectivenessMultiplier exists in dump.cs but is NOT [SerializeField] - it is a runtime value (SetEffectivenessMultiplier), so it is correctly absent.

bonusDamages_struct.present_on: Reckless Fury and Echo Weapon only - List<WeaponClassData>

localization.next_level_blurbs: LOC['Ability.<Type>.NextLevel.<StatName>'] - a GLOBAL shared vocabulary, not per ability. They name which stat a number is, which is what disambiguates e.g. wardArmor from wardHealth.
localization.placeholders: {0},{1},... are filled at runtime from the authored rank fields. A description may SKIP an index (Piercing Strikes uses {0},{2},{3}) because it reuses a shared template.

json_shape.grip_model: Maneuvers express one-handed vs two-handed ONLY through parameters.oneHandedMultiplier / twoHandedMultiplier, which scale parameters.bonusDamage. Two families exist: POWER-ATTACK family (0.5 / 1.0 - bonusDamage is the two-handed figure, one-handed gets half) and QUICK-STRIKES family (1.0 / 0.0 - two-handed gets NO bonus at all). Bash and Dodge families use 1.0 / 1.0.
json_shape.weapon_class_conditions: No maneuver or spell carries a weapon-class condition. Weapon class appears ONLY as (a) bonusDamages[].class on Reckless Fury / Echo Weapon and (b) the three per-class perks Scout(Light)/Armsman(Balanced)/Barbarian(Heavy), which express it in prose, not in a field.

gaps_and_warnings.ability: Mettle / Maximum Power / Augmented* / Enchantment Synergy
gaps_and_warnings.detail: Every one of the 20 perks serializes only Perk._bonusValue. The two exceptions are MatchingSetPerk (_slotsToCheck) and the enemy-only AtronachPowerPerk (_statusApplicationMultiplier/_statusApplicationDamageType). So the perks' SCOPE is defined ONLY by their description string. Mettle says 'Abilities' (all of them). Maximum Power says 'Spells ... while Magicka is full'. Augmented Flames/Frost/Poison/Shock say 'fire/frost/poison/shock damage' with NO source restriction. Enchantment Synergy says 'stacked enchantments' with no family restriction. An implementation narrower than those sentences is narrower than the data.
